about: Keith B. Schulefand, Esq. works from John James Audubon Parkway in Amherst and titles his site for divorce and family law. He is the named attorney and the site publishes a bio for him.

36 reviews at 3.4, the lowest rating of any firm here with more than thirty reviews. The site publishes no structured data, which costs it pillar D, and it explains one stage of a matrimonial case where most firms here explain three or more. It publishes no rate, no retainer figure and no flat fee.
